title: Bound skew and cubic responses with sharp odd-kernel frame floors
body:
## Summary

The specified two-site cleanup cannot yield a favorable complete native bill merely by changing skew J to an arbitrary-support Gaussian Clifford. The all-q written tariff removes the preceding two-plane restriction: exact transport and the paid occurrence inventory give **M≥n·ν(F_k J)**, allowing a charged nonmonomial first replacement. A separately charged unary support-metric extension has its own explicit implementation premise.

A separate whole-bank Gaussian Clifford trace gate limits any response satisfying U²+U+I=0 to native B rank≤2. The exact order-three tensor family already loses this quadratic relation at f=2, where the residual trace is6 and I,U₂,U₂² are independent. A three-power caller is outside that obstruction. These two fixed-interface results are grouped response boundaries, not a theorem about arbitrary simultaneous changes.

The neutral odd-rank examples now have two sharp fixed-word frame certificates: q2 floor66f with paths12/11/10/11/11/11, and q3 floor120f with eight rank15 paths. These equal their source bills under arbitrary Clifford-frame retiming, including gauges mixing tensor coordinates, at the fixed unary/common-frame ADD graphs and physical Z boundaries. Actual parents11f/15f remain distinct from ambient12f/16f. The complete independent graph/phase/inverse audit reconstructs the fixed witnesses without rerunning discovery. Selected-new-native lowering, spectator/borrowed-axis/owner/volume admission and changed graphs remain open; no Pauli fixed-frame corollary or all-q claim is added.

## Scope and limits

The skew theorem fixes the repeating scalar word, disjoint N planes, literal F_k J targets, two-sided isolated cuts, deletion of the entire D_u tail and complete separately charged J/N/Q/replacement inventory. The source-suffix proof gives all-parameter column/dual-row induction and occurrence counts. Complete actual physical source bindings are finite q2/q3; no all-q selected-native compiler follows. The two-plane special case retains neutral Pauli60/112 and odd-rank skew66/120 examples and explicitly clarifies the original even-index ellipsis without changing frozen proof bytes.

The λ extension requires each unary implementation to pay at least its maximum row/column logarithmic support, and a native/flat target for stock interpretation. Coupled-bank ADD paths, dirty helpers and free cross-boundary fusion do not inherit that premise. An unweighted moment consequence additionally requires equal-volume full-bank normalization and strictly smaller positive children. Unequal physical volumes require the actual weighted bridge; rank-zero scans remain paid. The cubic theorem requires unitary Clifford, Q(i) matrix entries and the quadratic identity on the entire bank. Non-Clifford, non-Gaussian, three-power and restricted-input interfaces remain separate.

Scientific base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority6 and original card stay pinned. Fresh canonical main `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f` changes only an unrelated sparse-baseline helper/test; guidance and selected record are unchanged. Explicit donor scope changes the joint-query-controller card; the broad card remains open. [PR4080](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4080) has the separate finite stock+4 construction and four fixed-word retiming floors; [PR4074](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4074) supplies the folded source. Fresh bounded overlap covers80 open PRs,12 exact related heads and4 boards with partial pagination. It is not a novelty certificate.

No favorable supplier, global caller/kernel optimum, formal-kernel proof, compatible BIT, complete physical owner/controller/precision/tape admission, selected-frontier change or new κ is claimed. [TASK.json](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f303d156a886d4ee866c926ec8439fde8d1dd63d/research/skew-cubic-response-gates/TASK.json) records next questions and blockers. Later coupled-tail research is outside this frozen contribution.
